name: Wayanad
description: Wayanad is a highland district in northeast Kerala, sitting at 700–2100m elevation in the Western Ghats, covered in coffee, tea and spice plantations alongside dense forest and tribal villages. It suits nature travelers, birdwatchers and those who want hill-station calm without the crowds of Ooty or Munnar. The terrain is genuinely hilly, roads are often narrow and winding, and the best experiences reward early risers and those comfortable with light trekking.
nearest_railhead: Kozhikode (Calicut) Railway Station (~75 km from Kalpetta)
nearest_airport: Calicut International Airport (CCJ), ~80 km from Kalpetta

attractions.name: Chembra Peak
attractions.description: At 2100m, Chembra is Wayanad's highest peak and a full-day trek through shola grasslands and forest. The heart-shaped lake near the summit is the main draw, but the ascent is steep and demanding — not a casual walk.

attractions.name: Soochipara (Sentinel Rock) Waterfalls
attractions.description: A three-tiered waterfall reached after a 20-minute forest trail from the ticketing checkpoint near Vellarimala. The pool at the base allows swimming and the forest walk itself is pleasant, but it gets crowded on weekends and holidays.

attractions.name: Edakkal Caves
attractions.description: Natural rock shelter on Ambukuthi Hill near Sulthan Bathery containing Neolithic and Iron Age petroglyphs estimated at 6000 years old. The climb to the caves is about 1.5 km uphill with some steep stone steps; the carvings are modest in scale but archaeologically significant.

attractions.name: Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary (Muthanga Range)
attractions.description: Part of the larger Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve, this sanctuary borders Nagarhole and Bandipur and holds reasonable elephant, gaur and deer populations. Jeep safaris from Muthanga gate run twice daily; sightings are likely but never guaranteed, and the forest is thicker than drier reserves so spotting requires patience.

attractions.name: Banasura Sagar Dam
attractions.description: India's largest earthen dam, set against the Banasura Hills with small islands visible during low-water months. Boat rides are available and the surroundings are scenic, but the site itself is a viewpoint and dam — not a wilderness experience.

attractions.name: Pookode Lake
attractions.description: A small natural freshwater lake at 770m elevation near Vythiri, surrounded by tropical forest. Pedal boating is available and a freshwater aquarium sits on the grounds. Compact and accessible, it can feel touristy and is best treated as a half-hour stopover rather than a destination in itself.

attractions.name: Thirunelli Temple
attractions.description: An ancient Vishnu temple of the 10th century or earlier, set in a valley surrounded by forested hills near Brahmagiri in northern Wayanad. The setting is genuinely serene and the architectural stonework is well-preserved; the site also holds ritual significance as a place for ancestral rites.

attractions.name: Kuruva Dweep (Kuruva Island)
attractions.description: A cluster of uninhabited river islands on the Kabani river near Mananthavady, accessible by bamboo raft or coracle. The riparian forest hosts several rare bird species and otters; the experience is calm and unhurried but facilities are minimal and entry is restricted to protect the ecosystem.

attractions.name: Kanthanpara Waterfalls
attractions.description: A lesser-visited waterfall set within a tea estate near Ambalavayal, reached via a short trail through working plantation rows. Relatively few tourists make the detour, which keeps it calm even during peak season — a genuine low-footfall alternative to the busier Soochipara.

attractions.name: Jain Temple, Sulthan Bathery
attractions.description: A 13th-century Jain temple in the heart of Sulthan Bathery town, built in Vijayanagara style and largely intact despite centuries of neglect. It is consistently overlooked by mainstream tour routes yet is among the most historically interesting structures in Wayanad — typically quiet even when the rest of the district is busy.
